name: Prompt Console
description: A two-row composer with a permission mode picker, a model picker and a context tab on top for the branch and folder.

props.name: modes
props.type: { id: string; label: string; description?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; tone?: "default" | "warning" }[]
props.description: Permission modes for the picker. The default set is Ask first, Auto, Plan and Bypass all; a warning tone paints the choice and the trigger yuzu.

props.name: mode
props.description: The chosen mode id (controlled). Use defaultMode when uncontrolled.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called when a mode is chosen.

props.name: context
props.type: { id?: string; label: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Chips shown in a tab on top of the panel, such as a branch and a folder.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder for the text area, which starts two lines tall.

props.name: value
props.description: The text (controlled). Also takes defaultValue and onChange, as PromptBox does.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called with the text on send or Enter. Shift+Enter adds a line.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Called when the stop button is pressed while streaming.

props.name: status
props.description: While streaming, the send arrow morphs into a stop square.

props.name: models
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Models for the picker beside the send button. Also takes model, defaultModel and onModelChange.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: Called with the files chosen after pressing +. Also takes accept and showAttach.

props.name: canSend
props.description: Overrides whether sending is allowed, which by default needs some text.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Lines the text area grows to before it scrolls.

props.name: children
props.description: Rendered inside the panel above the text area, for attachments.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other div props are spread onto it.
